title: Dems Can't Compel AI CEOs to Testify: Rep. McClellan
title_cn: 民主党不能强迫人工智能首席执行官作证：众议员麦克莱伦
summary: Representative Jennifer McClellan (D-VA) says she has yet to hear back from House Speaker Mike Johnson after calling for hearings with major AI executives, and acknowledges Democrats have limited ability in the minority to compel them to testify. The Virginia Democrat says Congress needs bipartisan action on AI safeguards and weighs in on her party's path forward as more progressive candidates compete in Democratic primaries. She speaks with Kailey Leinz and Joe Mathieu on the late edition of Bloomberg's "Balance of Power." (Source: Bloomberg)

title: CFTC Orders Kalshi to Keep Operating Despite New York Suit
title_cn: 尽管纽约提起诉讼，美国商品期货交易委员会仍命令 Kalshi 继续运营
summary: The Commodity Futures Trading Commission has ordered Kalshi to keep operating despite a legal attempt by New York’s government to shut down its operations.

title: Iran May Control Hormuz 'Forever': Sherman
title_cn: 谢尔曼：伊朗可能“永远”控制霍尔木兹
summary: Wendy Sherman, former US deputy secretary of state, weighs in on the hardening rhetoric between the US and Iran with a stark warning: "For the foreseeable future, if not forever, Iran will control the Strait of Hormuz." She says additional economic pressure from President Donald Trump is unlikely to make Iran's leadership cave. Sherman also discusses an upcoming summit between Trump and Chinese President Xi Jinping and Russia sanctions legislation passed by the Senate and awaiting House action. She speaks with Joe Mathieu and Kailey Leinz on the late edition of Bloomberg's "Balance of Power." (Source: Bloomberg)
